title: The Usurper's Gambit
description: Ecktoria, heir to the shattered Utaran Empire, teeters on the edge of civil war. A charismatic pretender, Duke Logan the Bold, has won the militia's loyalty and begun invoking the ancient rites that would claim the Mandate of Everflame. The recognized heir, King Aldric the Lame, clings to power through law, tradition, and the blessing of a wavering High Temple. The party must move through marble forums, sealed archives, and a besieged basilica to decide who — if anyone — deserves the crown, in a city where legitimacy is manufactured as often as it is inherited.
author: Nicholas A. Gasper

bestiary.name: New Militia Enforcer
bestiary.description: Fights in disciplined pairs. Loyal to Duke Logan.

sb_spends.name: Cordon the Street
sb_spends.effect: Seals an exit for the scene.

bestiary.name: Veteran Standard-Bearer
bestiary.description: Rallies allies and holds the line. Fights for Aldric or Logan depending on allegiance.

sb_spends.name: Hold the Line
sb_spends.effect: Gain +1 die to Body defense for self and one ally.

sb_spends.name: Rally Cry
sb_spends.effect: Allies clear 1 Fatigue and gain +1 die to Command until end of scene.

acts.title: Act I — Cracks in Marble
acts.description: The party witnesses, firsthand, how fragile Ecktoria's legitimacy has become — and learns to read ceremony as the weapon it is.

scenes.title: The Envoy's Humiliation
scenes.description: Before the Great Baths of Aurix, the Lame King's Envoy is struck from their ceremonial staff and jeered by a crowd primed for the Pretender's heralds. The party's reaction here becomes the city's first read on where they stand.

outcomes.clean: Defuse it; the Envoy names Grand Magistrate Thorne as a contact worth seeking.
outcomes.partial: Crowd disperses but the worst version of the story spreads. Legitimacy +1.
outcomes.miss: Envoy struck again publicly. Legitimacy +2; party marked as passive bystanders.

outcomes.clean: You identify the ringleaders and gain a lead on Logan's network.
outcomes.partial: You learn some names but are spotted; Legitimacy +1.
outcomes.miss: The crowd turns on you; you must flee or face a riot.

scenes.title: Statues and Sashes
scenes.description: Overnight, imperial statues have new crimson sashes and unfamiliar militia stand where grey-sashed Standard-Bearers once did — a subtle, deniable, unsettling shift.

outcomes.clean: You find a hidden marker tying the sashes to Logan's quartermaster.
outcomes.partial: You confirm the shift but gain little actionable evidence.
outcomes.miss: You are spotted by militia; they detain you for questioning.

outcomes.clean: You slip past or bribe them; gain information on their numbers.
outcomes.partial: They let you pass but are now suspicious; future interactions are Desperate.
outcomes.miss: A fight breaks out; defeat or escape.

outcomes.clean: You learn the crowd's mood: they favor Logan, but many are undecided.
outcomes.partial: You hear conflicting rumors; gain a lead but also attract unwanted attention.
outcomes.miss: You are overheard; Legitimacy +1 against you.

acts.title: Act II — Shadows in the Censorium
acts.description: Grand Magistrate Thorne is attacked in her own hall. The party must dig into Ecktoria's buried legal truths — and discover the answer is messier than either faction wants.

scenes.title: The Magistrate's Hall
scenes.description: Thorne is found bleeding among scattered files. Someone wanted a specific document before she could act on it.

outcomes.clean: You save her and she reveals the document was about the Line of Fire.
outcomes.partial: She lives but speaks cryptically; you must investigate further.
outcomes.miss: She dies; the document is lost, and you are framed for the attack.

outcomes.clean: You follow the trail to a safehouse with evidence of Logan's involvement.
outcomes.partial: You find a clue but the attacker escapes; advance Legal Standing for one side.
outcomes.miss: You are ambushed; fight or flee.

scenes.title: The Censor's Hall
scenes.description: A labyrinth of red-lacquered tablets and censored histories, holding the Line of Fire — the genealogical record of every legitimate claimant in a century.

outcomes.clean: You find the Line of Fire and learn both claims are flawed.
outcomes.partial: You find part of the truth but trigger an alarm; must escape quickly.
outcomes.miss: You are caught; imprisoned or exiled.

outcomes.clean: Both claims turn out partly flawed — Aldric's formalized through a shortcut, Logan's bloodline more distant than advertised. Gain the Pact of Three Flames clause as leverage.
outcomes.partial: One side's claim is shakier — but you can't yet prove which.
outcomes.miss: You misread the censored annotations and reach a plausible but wrong conclusion.

acts.title: Act III — Coin, Steel, and Fire
acts.description: The Pretender's forces blockade the Fire-Blessed Basilica. Every alliance the party built now becomes leverage — or liability.

scenes.title: The Coin-House Floor
scenes.description: Ecktoria's financial temple decides, quietly, which faction can actually afford to win.

outcomes.clean: You secure funding for Aldric or deny it to Logan; Legitimacy shifts in your favor.
outcomes.partial: You gain some resources but cause a scandal; Legitimacy +1 for your opponent.
outcomes.miss: The Coin-House turns hostile; you are blacklisted.

outcomes.clean: You bring new coin into the city; Legitimacy advances for your chosen faction.
outcomes.partial: You gain some support but at a high cost; lose a Boon.
outcomes.miss: They side with Logan; Legitimacy +2 for him.

scenes.title: The Basilica Blockade
scenes.description: Logan's militia rings the Fire-Blessed Basilica. High Priest Dominicus, trapped inside, is torn between stability and a renewal he isn't sure is genuine.

outcomes.clean: You force a path to the Basilica; you can enter and speak with Dominicus.
outcomes.partial: You get through but at a cost: lose 1 Boon and gain a wound.
outcomes.miss: The blockade holds; you are repelled and the siege tightens.

outcomes.clean: You convince him to withhold blessing until the true claimant is proven; gain his trust.
outcomes.partial: He hesitates but agrees to wait; you gain time but no firm commitment.
outcomes.miss: He decides to bless Logan to avoid bloodshed; Coronation Readiness advances by 2.

acts.title: Act IV — The Coronation of Ash or Glory
acts.description: Every thread converges into a single ritual hour — a public reckoning over what legitimacy actually means.

scenes.title: The Reckoning at the Basilica
scenes.description: Aldric, Logan, and whatever third option the party has built converge at the Basilica steps as the crowd watches to see who blinks first.

outcomes.clean: You present irrefutable evidence and the crowd turns away from Logan.
outcomes.partial: You weaken Logan's position but he still has support; a compromise is needed.
outcomes.miss: Your argument fails; Logan's coronation proceeds by force.

outcomes.clean: Dominicus publicly endorses the rightful claimant (or no one) based on evidence you've provided.
outcomes.partial: He gives a divided verdict; civil war seems inevitable.
outcomes.miss: He blesses Logan; Aldric is deposed.

npcs.name: King Aldric the Lame
npcs.motivation: Preserve legitimate succession and imperial stability.
npcs.secret: His claim was formalized through a procedural shortcut two generations back.

npcs.name: Duke Logan the Bold
npcs.motivation: Seize power through popular support and promised reform.
npcs.secret: His bloodline claim is real, but far more distant than his heralds advertise.

npcs.name: Grand Magistrate Valeria Thorne
npcs.role: Keeper of imperial law and succession precedent
npcs.motivation: Preserve legal integrity, even when it's inconvenient.
npcs.secret: Has known of the flaw in Aldric's formalization for years, buried out of loyalty.

npcs.name: High Priest Dominicus
npcs.role: Keeper of the Sacred Brazier and the Everflame
npcs.motivation: Ensure whoever receives divine sanction actually deserves it.
npcs.secret: Has already privately decided not to bless a coronation built on force alone.

npcs.name: The Lame King's Envoy
npcs.motivation: Advance Aldric's cause through means he cannot use himself.
npcs.secret: Quietly investigating whether Aldric's own claim will survive scrutiny.

factions.name: The Lame King's Line
factions.goals: Preserve legitimate succession and imperial stability.
factions.relationship: Controlled, slipping toward Desperate. DV for alliance: 4/5/6+.

factions.goals: Seize power through popular support and promised reform.
factions.relationship: Dominant through popular momentum, shallow on legal standing. DV for alliance: 3/4/5+.

factions.goals: Hidden, patient, seeking to influence succession from the shadows.
factions.relationship: Hidden, Controlled, patient. DV for alliance: 4/5/6+.

campaignTimers.name: Legitimacy
campaignTimers.description: Tracks the drift of opinion toward the Pretender. When full, Logan controls the capital regardless of legal question.

campaignTimers.name: Coronation Readiness
campaignTimers.description: How prepared Logan's faction is to force a coronation. When full, coronation proceeds by force.

notes: This adventure is a political intrigue with a heavy focus on legitimacy, legal evidence, and public perception. The party must gather evidence, sway factions, and navigate a city where ceremony is politics. The GM should track each faction's standing and the timers closely.

_gmhints.tone: Ecktoria is a city where every mosaic is a political statement and every sash color is a declaration of war. The tone is tense, cynical, and theatrical—legitimacy is manufactured, but the people believe in the theater. The party should feel like they are navigating a minefield of symbols and alliances.

pacing.act1: Establish Ecktoria as a place where ceremony IS politics. Let the party's reaction to the Envoy's humiliation set their initial reputation.
pacing.act2: The genealogical puzzle is the mechanical centerpiece — both claims are real but compromised. This is the natural, sad consequence of an empire quietly cutting corners for generations, not a shocking betrayal.
pacing.act3: Every relationship or piece of leverage from earlier acts should matter here. Track who owes the party what.
pacing.act4: If the party has built a strong case, let mechanics reflect they've effectively already won — this act is about whether the city accepts that victory. Reward creative third-path solutions generously.

npcSecrets.aldric: His claim was formalized through a procedural shortcut two generations back. He is aware of it but has hidden it out of pride.
npcSecrets.logan: His bloodline claim is real but far more distant than advertised. He knows this and overcompensates with populism.
npcSecrets.thorne: She has known of the flaw in Aldric's formalization for years, buried out of loyalty to the institution. Her attack was likely by Logan's agents who suspected her knowledge.
npcSecrets.dominicus: He has already decided not to bless a coronation built on force. He will only bless a candidate who proves legitimacy.
npcSecrets.envoy: The envoy is quietly investigating both claims, possibly to undermine Aldric if needed—he is not entirely loyal.

forbiddenEarlyRevelations: Don't reveal both claims are flawed before Act II's archive discovery.
Keep Thorne evasive about her knowledge until trust is earned.
Keep Dominicus's private decision hidden until Act IV.
Let the Silent Opposition's role surface through investigation, not exposition.

politicalTactics.legitimacyTimer: Use this as a pressure gauge. The party's actions in public, their alliances, and their ability to sway opinion affect this timer. When it fills, Logan's popular support becomes unstoppable.
politicalTactics.legalStanding: These timers represent the strength of each claimant's documented evidence. The party can increase these by finding documents, securing testimonies, or discrediting the other side.
politicalTactics.coronationReadiness: This represents Logan's military and logistical readiness to force a coronation. The party can slow it by disrupting his supplies, exposing his agents, or rallying the militia to Aldric.
